entries.subject: SDSS DR9 color HiPS
entries.finding: A 2700 x 2700 px hips2fits cutout of CDS/P/SDSS9/color, 23.1 arcmin wide on the HyperLEDA position. The red channel reaches 255 at the nucleus (brightest pixel 255, 221, 141 of 255). In 20 arcsec elliptical annuli the cleaned light comes within one count of the corner sky at 580 arcsec, inside the 693.426 arcsec the spheroid reaches.

entries.subject: A flat picture facing the Sun
entries.finding: M60 was first drawn as one flat Sloan picture facing the Sun, the route of the Messier galaxies with no published shape. Seen from the side that picture is a line. Kormendy et al. publish M60's profile and shape, so the volume replaces it.

entries.subject: Catalogues for the masks
entries.finding: HyperLEDA PGC sizes 9 neighbours; the 2MASS Extended Source Catalog sizes 4 that HyperLEDA lists without a D25. NOX leaves the haloes of bright stars, so 27 Gaia DR3 stars brighter than G = 15 are masked too. At M87's three D25 radii a close neighbour's mask covers M60's own centre, so each mask stops at nine tenths of its distance from the centre. At half the distance, the first limit tried, the mask of NGC 4647, the spiral 152 arcsec from M60's centre, stopped inside that galaxy's own disc and left a ring of its light.

entries.subject: Spheroid
entries.finding: Kormendy et al. (2009), Table 1, row NGC 4649: major-axis Sérsic fit n = 5.36 (+0.38, -0.32), r_e = 132.05 (+11.6, -9.3) arcsec. Table 3 rows at 125.507 and 138.569 arcsec, interpolated to the half-light radius: ellipticity 0.203, position angle 106.0 degrees. Used as published; no fit was made here.

entries.subject: Globular cluster dots
entries.finding: Jordán et al. (2009), Table 4, VCC 1978: the 807 sources with a probability of being a globular cluster of at least 0.5, the authors' own cut, drawn as dots through the same spheroid. They fill only the Hubble field on the centre.
